content.text: Roki Sasaki takes the mound for the first time this season as the Los Angeles Dodgers start a three-game series against Jose Ramirez and the Cleveland Guardians.MORE: MLB preseason power rankingsDate: Monday, March 30, 2026Time: 10:10 p.m. ETTV Channel: SportsNet LA, MLB Cleveland Guardians, MLB.TVAdvertisementThe Dodgers are off to a great start with a perfect 3-0 record and turn their attention to the Guardians after sweeping the Diamondbacks in their opening series. Los Angeles remains the team to beat in MLB, led by superstars Shohei Ohtani, Mookie Betts, and Freddie Freeman. They almost certainly will make it back to the postseason once again this year, as they look to win a third straight World Series title for the first time since the Yankees over 25 years ago.Live Stream Dodgers vs GuardiansAt 2-2, the Guardians find themselves in the middle of the pack when it comes to the AL East standings. They return many of the same players that helped them make a postseason run in 2025, and will hope for similar regular-season success in 2026. Their pitching staff has looked solid out of the gate, keeping them competitive in each matchup, while the offense has had flashes of production but hasn’t fully found its rhythm yet.
